authority.rule: OpenAPI remains the final endpoint machine contract; prose examples do not authorize inventing missing request/query/success schemas.

classifications.A: SE-API-001 V1.2 and the current machine contracts fully freeze the operation-specific request/query/success shape and current runtime has enough authoritative domain behavior to activate without inventing semantics.
classifications.B: An existing subordinate V2.1.2 contract supplies the missing domain response shape, but a separate frozen runtime authorization/resource-resolution rule is still missing, so the public route remains contract-only.
classifications.C: At least one operation-specific request/query/success or behavior decision is still not frozen by SE-API-001 V1.2 or a current subordinate machine contract.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 36 provides a request example and generic 201 envelope guidance.
SE-DATA-001 V2.0 freezes Site as the canonical Tenant -> Site -> Space -> Asset -> Device -> Point chain member.
The active Registry machine contract freezes the canonical Site projection as id/tenantId/code/displayName/timezone/status/revision/createdAt/updatedAt.
runtimeEvidence: platform-core-service Registry runtime is read-only for Site list/detail; it has no Create Site handler, write action or persistence command boundary.
blockingGaps: The SE-API-001 example uses siteCode/name/siteType/latitude/longitude while the canonical Site projection uses code/displayName/timezone/status/revision; the write DTO mapping is not frozen.
Required/optional/null semantics, create authorization, uniqueness/conflict behavior and the exact created Site response are not frozen.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 39 freezes the URI and Campus -> Building -> Floor -> Room purpose.
SE-DATA-001 V2.0 explicitly freezes Space Tree != Asset Tree != Energy Topology.
The current SiteAssetModel machine contract contains canonical Space records with parentSpaceId but is not a Space Tree public projection contract.
runtimeEvidence: platform-core-service can read the canonical Site Asset Model, but does not expose a distinct Space Tree public/internal projection.
blockingGaps: Tree node schema, node type/code/name fields, child representation, ordering, empty-tree semantics and success data shape are not frozen.
Deriving a tree from SiteAssetModel would invent a public projection and would violate the frozen separation between Space Tree and Asset Tree.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 48 lists page/pageSize/siteId/gatewayId/deviceType/onlineStatus filters and the generic list envelope.
The current Registry machine contract freezes Device and DeviceCollection, while the active public Registry route is Site-scoped GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/devices using limit/cursor.
runtimeEvidence: platform-core-service supports Site-scoped Device list reads but not the unscoped/filter-rich GET /api/v1/devices contract.
blockingGaps: The endpoint-specific Device summary projection is not frozen.
SE-API-001 page/pageSize conflicts with the active Registry limit/cursor contract, and gatewayId/onlineStatus filtering semantics are not frozen for Registry Device metadata.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 50 freezes the URI and Standard Point consumption rule.
SE-DATA-001 V2.0 freezes Point as the canonical data point and Sensor as optional physical lifecycle metadata.
The current SiteAssetModel machine contract freezes the canonical TelemetryPoint schema.
runtimeEvidence: Registry runtime can return TelemetryPoint records inside SiteAssetModel, but does not expose a Device Point list projection with its own ordering/filter/envelope contract.
blockingGaps: The endpoint-specific list envelope, Point summary/detail projection, ordering and filter behavior are not frozen.
Reusing the whole SiteAssetModel or silently filtering it in Gateway would create an undocumented public contract.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 sections 52-54 provide pointIds request shape and require value/unit/quality/event timestamp in results.
SE-DATA-001 V2.0 freezes quality values GOOD/PARTIAL/ESTIMATED/MANUAL/STALE/INVALID and the latest out-of-order NO_UPDATE rule.
S2 current subordinate contract freezes Device Observation Snapshots and explicitly retires the older POST /api/v1/telemetry/latest/batch route.
runtimeEvidence: Current S2 Gateway/runtime reads are Device-centric Observation Snapshot operations, not Point-centric latest batch reads.
blockingGaps: The exact value union/nullability and missing/stale/unauthorized per-point semantics are not frozen.
The <=1000 point limit is a recommendation rather than a frozen contract limit.
The Device Observation Snapshot contract cannot be silently reused as the Point-centric SE-API-001 contract.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 sections 55-58 freeze pointId/from/to/interval/aggregation and avg/min/max/last/delta.
SE-DATA-001 V2.0 freezes Point identity, event time/ingest time and telemetry quality semantics.
telemetryhistorymodel and the S2 subordinate contract freeze a different DeviceHistory query: deviceId + keys + from/to + maxPointsPerKey with a DeviceHistoryResponse series model.
runtimeEvidence: Current telemetry-query runtime implements bounded Device history and does not implement the Point-centric interval/aggregation GET contract.
blockingGaps: The exact Point history series/item success schema, quality/timestamp representation, empty-series semantics and concrete interval/aggregation guardrails are not frozen.
The existing DeviceHistory model cannot be exposed under this URI because its selector and result semantics materially differ.

sourceCoverage: SE-DOMAIN-ALARM-001 V1.0 freezes siteId as required public scope, limit/cursor pagination, severity/status filters, default limit 50 and maximum 200.
The S4 subordinate machine contract freezes CursorAlarmListResponse and opaque cursor semantics bound to Site and filters.

SE-DOMAIN-ALARM-001 V1.0 freezes the BOLA-safe rule: resolve alarmId inside Tenant first, then authorize the authoritative Site; missing/cross-Tenant/out-of-Site-scope resources converge to 404 ALARM_NOT_FOUND.
S4 subordinate V2.1.2 freezes AlarmEnvelope/Alarm response shape.
SE-DOMAIN-ALARM-001 V1.0 freezes ACK as an acknowledgement fact independent from lifecycle state, with optional comment and optional Idempotency-Key.
The same document freezes natural idempotency, no expectedVersion requirement, first-ack preservation and the BOLA-safe alarmId -> Site resolution rule.
SE-API-001 V1.2 section 109 freezes the URI and section 113 requires target/subject/forecastOrigin/forecastFor/granularity/modelVersion/featureSetVersion/quality.

SE-AI-001 V1.0 CURRENT freezes Forecast Result core fields including forecast_id/tenant_id/site_id/subject_type/subject_id/target/forecast_origin/forecast_for/horizon_minutes/value/unit/bounds/model_version/feature_set_version/input_snapshot_id/quality/generated_at.
SE-AI-001 Forecast API sections are explicitly recommendation/example material and propose GET /api/v1/forecasts and GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId}/forecasts/day-ahead rather than this exact route.
runtimeEvidence: forecast-service currently exposes internal POST /v1/forecast for inference and returns internal Point records; it has no public Load Forecast GET projection.
blockingGaps: Exact query parameters, public series/value item schema, time horizon selection and fallback representation for this URI are not frozen.
The internal inference Request includes deployment/model/input-snapshot fields and cannot be exposed as the public read contract.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 110 freezes the URI and section 113 requires target/subject/forecastOrigin/forecastFor/granularity/modelVersion/featureSetVersion/quality.
SE-AI-001 V1.0 CURRENT freezes PV_GENERATION as a P0 forecast target and the common Forecast Result core fields.
SE-AI-001 public API sections remain recommendation/example material and do not freeze this exact PV route's query or envelope.
runtimeEvidence: forecast-service internal POST /v1/forecast accepts PV_GENERATION but no public PV Forecast GET projection exists.
blockingGaps: Exact query parameters, public series/value item schema, time horizon selection and fallback representation for this URI are not frozen.
The internal inference model is not a public read resource contract.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 116 freezes the URI and recommends 202 Accepted.
SE-AI-002 V1.0 CURRENT freezes Optimization Run core fields and the run states CREATED/VALIDATING/SOLVING/FEASIBLE/INFEASIBLE/FAILED/PUBLISHED/EXPIRED.
SE-AI-002 API section explicitly labels POST /api/v1/optimization/runs as a recommendation rather than an exact machine contract.
runtimeEvidence: optimization-service currently exposes internal POST /v1/optimize with a solver input snapshot Request and returns a Plan synchronously with 201; it does not create the public asynchronous OptimizationRun resource.
blockingGaps: The public CreateOptimizationRunRequest is not frozen: the current internal Request contains server/internal snapshot, checksum, policy, topology, forecast and resource state fields.
Idempotency requirement, 202 accepted payload, resource Location/ID semantics and domain validation/error mapping are not frozen.

sourceCoverage: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 117 freezes the URI and generic async status guidance.
SE-AI-002 V1.0 CURRENT defines Optimization Run core fields/status and a proposed optimization_run table, but its API section remains recommendation-level.
SE-AI-002 contains multiple domain/storage projections (run_id vs id; started/finished fields vs created_at/objective_value/solve_time_ms), so an exact public Run projection is not implied.
runtimeEvidence: optimization-service has no GET Run handler or public durable OptimizationRun read resource; its current HTTP surface is only internal POST /v1/optimize plus health.
blockingGaps: The exact OptimizationRun public resource, state timestamps, result/error fields and output/Dispatch Plan references are not frozen.
A durable public Run read model and authorization path do not yet exist.

manualVsMachineDrift.manual: SE-API-001 V1.2 section 31 shows username/password JSON login.
manualVsMachineDrift.machineContract: Current OpenAPI contracts OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE through POST /api/v1/auth/login using returnTo query semantics.
manualVsMachineDrift.reason: SE-API-001 V1.2 explicitly ranks current OpenAPI above the handbook examples for endpoint-specific contract details.

manualVsMachineDrift.manual: SE-API-001 V1.2 standard list shape uses page/pageSize with default 50 and maximum 200.
manualVsMachineDrift.machineContract: Current active Registry public lists use limit/cursor opaque cursor pagination.
manualVsMachineDrift.reason: Changing an active pagination model is an endpoint contract change and cannot be inferred from the handbook without an explicit OpenAPI migration.

manualVsMachineDrift.manual: SE-DATA-001 V2.0 freezes Space and Asset as canonical while removing Organization/ThingsBoard legacy concerns.
manualVsMachineDrift.machineContract: Current Registry runtime emits ASSET -> SPACE and DEVICE -> ASSET relationships; platform OpenAPI and generated clients have been synchronized to ASSET/SPACE.
manualVsMachineDrift.reason: This is a machine-contract drift correction, not a compatibility alias; old AREA/EQUIPMENT relationship enums are not retained.

decision.reason: All 10 remaining routes were re-reviewed against SE-DATA-001 V2.0 CURRENT, SE-AI-001 V1.0 CURRENT, SE-AI-002 V1.0 CURRENT, current Registry/S2 machine contracts and actual Forecast/Optimization runtime. No additional operation satisfies A: Registry routes still lack endpoint-specific write/tree/list projections, Point-centric Telemetry routes differ materially from the current Device-centric S2 contracts, Forecast public route projections remain recommendation-level, and Optimization currently exposes only an internal synchronous solver endpoint rather than a durable public Run resource. The 10 routes therefore remain fail-closed until their exact public machine contracts are frozen.
